title: Benefits of Blogging
excerpt: Blogging is a great way to share your knowledge and expertise with the world. However, until now, bloggers have had to use several different services to create, maintain and promote their blogs. Blogging is an increasingly popular medium to generate leads and customers. If a business has a blog, they're more likely to convert their leads into customers. Notion can help you build, maintain and promote your blog.
metaDescription: Blogging is an increasingly popular medium to generate leads and customers. If a business has a blog, they're more likely to convert their leads into customers.
contentHtml:
Why should you start a blog?

Writing blog posts and managing your blog is easy with Notion. You can write posts directly in Notion by typing them in. From inside Notion, you can also preview your blog to see how it looks. You can edit your blog posts by clicking into them, making changes, and then saving them.

The Notion backend is where you'll find your blog, along with several blog settings. Managing the blog is simple: you can upload images and assets to your blog, create categories for your posts, name your blog, and even control who can view it.

Benefits of Blogging

Blogging is easy and free and it's a great tool for reaching a larger audience. Blogging is a great way to share your opinion and ideas with people who you would have never been able to reach previously. Blogging also gives you a chance to practice your writing skills and perfect them. Instead of depending on the people who are already in your social circles and telling them to read your blog, you can write for a mass audience where anyone can read it.

Not only will you gain a larger audience, but you'll also learn more about your audience and how to cater to them. Blogging is a fantastic way to gain skills in writing and working with your audience and it's also a great way to make money as a writer.
